sn46.57:1.2: Aṭṭhikasaññā bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā || || 3.
sn46.57:1.3: Katham bhāvitā ca bhikkhave aṭṭhikasaññā katham bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā || || 4.
sn46.57:1.4: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu aṭṭhikasaññāsahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || pa [pe] ||
sn46.57:1.5: aṭṭhikasaññāsahagatam upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || || 5.
sn46.57:1.6: Evam bhavitā kho bhikkhave aṭṭhikasannā evam bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsāti || || 2.
sn46.57:2.1: Aṭṭhikasaññāya bhikkhave bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya dvinnam phalānam aññataram phalam pāṭikaṅkhaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme aññā || sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā || || 3.
sn46.57:2.2: Katham bhāvitāya ca kho bhikkhave aṭṭhikasaññāya katham bahulīkatāya dvinnam phalānam aññataraṃ phalam pāṭikaṅkhaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme aññā || sati vā upādisese anāgamitā || || 4.

sn46.57:2.5: Evam bhāvitāya kho bhikkhave aṭṭhikasaññāya evam bahulīkatāya dvinnam phalānam aññataram phalam pāṭikaṅkham diṭṭheva dhamme aññā || sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā || || 2.
